items.briefing:
Australian ed-tech platform Mathspace has disclosed a data breach affecting over one million people — if your organisation uses Mathspace, staff or student personal information may be at risk. Separately, a timely reminder that AI is increasingly being used to make scams and social engineering attacks more convincing, with criminals using personalised, AI-generated messages to bypass people's usual instincts about what looks suspicious.

If you receive an unexpected message — even one that feels personal or urgent — verify the sender through a separate channel before clicking links or sharing any information.

featured.title: Pronto adds AI tools to Xi ERP as it marks 50 years
featured.summary: Built-in generative, predictive and agentic features aim to cut manual work and sharpen forecasting for more than 1,500 Pronto Xi users.
